<p>Item 2.02. Results of Operations and Financial Condition.</p>
<p>On March 15, 2024, Acme Widgets Corp issued a press release announcing its
financial results for the fiscal quarter ended February 29, 2024. A copy of
the press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated
herein by reference.</p>
</body>

<h1>Acme Widgets Corp Reports Record Quarterly Revenue of $412 Million</h1>
<p>ACME CITY, March 15, 2024 -- Acme Widgets Corp (NASDAQ: ACME) today reported
revenue of $412 million for the quarter, up 18% year-over-year, beating
analyst consensus estimates of $390 million. The company also raised its
full-year guidance to $1.65-$1.70 billion, citing strong demand across all
product lines.</p>
<p>"This was an exceptional quarter," said Jane Smith, CEO.</p>
</body>
